body:
## Changes

* feat: add `dprint install` command (#1339)
* fix(BREAKING): use a dash as the range separator in `--lines` (ex. `10-20`) (#1341)
* perf: reduce allocations when formatting and resolving files (#1354)
* fix: inherit the ancestor config in a main config with `"inherit": true` (#1340)
* fix: do not exit the editor service when the config fails to resolve on a format request (#1342)
* fix: include lengths when hashing configuration for incremental formatting (#1343)
* fix: respond to format requests the editor service cancels on a config change (#1344)
* fix: clamp the format range to the text in the editor service (#1345)
* fix: exit the editor service instead of panicking when its output is closed (#1346)
* fix: keep the editor service responding while the config is resolved (#1347)
* fix: provide plugins the file path with the shebang's extension for files matched by a shebang (#1349)
* fix: say when a plugin was already installed in dprint install (#1350)
* fix: support --plugins with dprint install (#1351)
* fix: warn instead of erroring when there is no config file to inherit from (#1353)


## Install

Run `dprint upgrade` or see https://dprint.dev/install/

## Verification

These artifacts have [build provenance attestations](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-for-github-actions/using-artifact-attestations/using-artifact-attestations-to-establish-provenance-for-builds).
Verify a download with the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/):

```shell
gh attestation verify dprint-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip --repo dprint/dprint
```
